jobs.occupation: Senior IT Security Specialist to our client in Malmö!
jobs.description:
Join our customer in a global security initiative shaping the future of data protection. In this key role, you will collaborate closely with Microsoft to lead the configuration and rollout of Microsoft Purview DLP across a global enterprise.
About the role
As a Senior IT Security Specialist, you will act as the Subject Matter Expert for Microsoft Purview and DLP. You will bridge the gap between technical implementation and business productivity, collaborating with Group Security, IT, Legal, and business units to ensure a secure yet productive digital workplace.
You are offered
An exciting opportunity to drive a high-impact gobal security initiative in close collaboration with Microsoft
A dynamic environment with significant professional influence

Work tasks
You will lead the technical configuration, testing, and deployment of Microsoft Purview DLP while managing the organizational change and communication required for a successful rollout.
Configure rules and policies in Microsoft Purview in collaboration with Microsoft  
Analyze test logs and evaluate next steps for policy optimization  
Review classification levels, sensitivity labels, and protection mechanisms  
Identify and prioritize critical enterprise data in dialogue with system owners  
Design policies, rules, sensitivity labels, and end-user Policy Tips  
Create training materials and conduct briefings for end-users and IT support

We are looking for you who have
Advanced knowledge and documented experience in Microsoft Purview architecture and configuration (DLP, Information Protection, Insider Risk Management)
Proven experience leading the full DLP lifecycle from data mapping to live activation
Deep understanding of Microsoft 365 integrations (Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, Teams, Endpoint DLP)
Strong track record of applying Change Management principles during security rollouts
Ability to communicate in advanced English

It is meritorious if you have
SC-400 or SC-100 certifications
Experience translating regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, ISO 27001) into technical DLP rules
Experience collaborating with Microsoft FastTrack
Ability to communicate in Swedish

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:
Social
Orderly
Responsible
Respectful

Our recruitment process
This recruitment process is handled by Academic Work and it is our client’s wish that all questions regarding the position is directed to Academic Work.
Our selection process is continuous and the advert may close before the recruitment process is completed if we have moved forward to the next phase. The process includes two tests: one personality test and one cognitive test. The tests are tools to find the right talent for the right position, to enable equality, diversity, and a fair process.

jobs.occupation: HSE ADVISOR  CONSTRUCTION PROJECT  FINLAND (ROTATIONAL WORK)
jobs.description:
ICE Point Enterprises AB
Location: Finland
Work Schedule: Rotational shifts
Start Date: As soon as possible
Employment Type: Full-time
Job Description
ICE Point Enterprises AB is looking for an experienced and dedicated HSE Advisor to join our team on a large-scale construction project in Finland.
The role involves supporting and monitoring health, safety and environmental procedures on site, ensuring that all employees and subcontractors follow applicable safety regulations, project requirements and company policies.
The HSE Advisor will work closely with site management, supervisors, subcontractors and the client's HSE team to maintain a safe working environment throughout the project.
Key Responsibilities
Monitor and ensure compliance with site HSE requirements and safety procedures.
Conduct regular site inspections and safety walks.
Identify hazards and assess workplace risks.
Support the implementation of risk assessments and method statements (RAMS).
Conduct toolbox talks and safety briefings.
Investigate incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions.
Follow up on corrective and preventive actions.
Ensure employees and subcontractors comply with PPE requirements.
Monitor employee training, certifications and site safety inductions.
Maintain HSE documentation, inspection reports and safety records.
Promote a positive safety culture across the project.
Report HSE performance and concerns to site management.

Requirements
Previous experience as an HSE Advisor, HSE Officer or similar role within construction or industrial projects.
Knowledge of construction site health and safety procedures.
Experience with risk assessments, method statements and incident reporting.
Good understanding of PPE requirements and workplace safety.
Relevant HSE qualifications or certifications.
Good English communication skills, both written and spoken.
Ability to work independently and take responsibility.
Strong communication and problem-solving skills.
Experience from data centre or large-scale construction projects is an advantage.

What We Offer
Full-time employment on an international construction project.
Rotational work schedule.
Accommodation fully provided and paid for by the company.
Flights to and from Finland covered by the company.
Necessary travel expenses covered.
Competitive salary based on experience.
Opportunity to work with an experienced international project team.

How to Apply
Interested candidates are welcome to submit their CV to faktura@icepoint.se
Please include relevant HSE experience, qualifications and availability.
ICE Point Enterprises AB
We look forward to receiving your application!
Öppen för alla
Vi fokuserar på din kompetens, inte dina övriga förutsättningar. Vi är öppna för att anpassa rollen eller arbetsplatsen efter dina behov.

Do you enjoy being close to customers, identifying growth opportunities and turning them into concrete sales?
We are looking for an Area Sales Manager to join Kekkilä-BVB’s Nordic Retail Sales team in Sweden for Hasselfors Garden. You will be commercially responsible for your own territory and develop both existing and new customers.
Our field-sales model focuses time where sales work can make a difference: growing priority customers, developing assortments, improving brand visibility and placement and discovering new business opportunities.
What you will do
Develop and execute short- and long-term sales plans for your territory.
Grow sales and profitability with prioritised customers and build sustainable, long-term partnerships.
Use customer and sales data to prioritise customer activity, visits and routes.
Develop assortments through cross-selling, pre-sales and customer-specific growth opportunities.
Ensure strong brand visibility, product placement, availability and distribution in priority customers.
Identify and convert new local customer opportunities.
Lead seasonal pre-sales with prioritised private garden centres and agreed chain and key-account locations.
Use digital selling methods and sales-support tools alongside physical customer visits.
Work closely with KAMs and other functions and maintain high-quality customer and opportunity information in CRM.

Preferred location: Mid-East Sweden or close to the Stockholm area. Regular customer travel is an essential part of the role. The role reports to the Vice President, Sales Retail & Professional.
What we are looking for
You do not need to tick every box. We are looking for a commercially curious and proactive person who enjoys developing customers and business and is comfortable taking ownership.
Experience in field sales, retail sales or customer development.
Strong commercial drive and the ability to work independently.
Good understanding of sales, margin, profitability and customer potential.
Strong sales, negotiation and communication skills.
The ability to plan and prioritise a geographically broad customer portfolio.
A collaborative and solution-focused approach.
Interest in gardening products and the retail market.
Confidence in using CRM, forecasting and digital sales tools.
This is an active field sales role requiring frequent travel across the assigned territory, systematic route planning and regular face-to-face customer meetings.
Fluent Swedish and English

If you want to combine customer relationships, commercial thinking and hands-on sales, we would be happy to hear from you.
Contact Information
We cooperate with Consensus for this recruitment. For further information, please contact Lena Ahlin +46 70 374 34 94. We look forward to receiving your application as soon as possible, but latest by 29 November at www.consensus.nu (http://www.consensus.nu).

jobs.occupation: Experienced carpenter for new-build and renovation projects
jobs.description:
TN Bygg Järfälla AB is a family-owned construction company working on new-build and renovation projects in the Stockholm area. To strengthen our team, we are now looking for two experienced carpenters.
As a carpenter with us, you will work on a variety of projects, both independently and with colleagues in larger teams. You will work from drawings and be responsible for the quality of your work from start to finish.
Duties
The role includes:
Framing and fit-out work, such as external infill walls, stud and plasterboard partitions, suspended ceilings and boxing-in
Installing windows, balcony doors, and internal and external doors
Complete installation of kitchens and bathroom units
Adapting and fitting cabinets, wardrobes and built-in storage to drawings
Fitting skirting boards, architraves and mouldings

About you
We are looking for a confident and experienced carpenter. You do not need to be an expert in every area, but you have a solid foundation and take care to deliver high-quality work.
Requirements:
At least five years of documented experience as a carpenter in new-build and/or renovation
Able to read drawings and work from them independently
Good physical fitness, as the work is physically demanding
Good spoken and written English or Swedish
Right to work in Sweden

Desirable:
Trade certificate (yrkesbevis) or equivalent
Driving licence (category B)
Certificates and training relevant to the tasks above

We place great emphasis on attention to detail and a responsible approach to work.
What we offer
You will join a well-run family business with skilled colleagues. As part of our team, you will get:
Varied projects in new-build and renovation, on well-organised sites
Opportunities for professional development
A workplace where good work is recognised and appreciated
Permanent full-time employment, starting with a probationary period
Pay based on experience, with terms under the Swedish collective agreement for the construction sector (Byggavtalet)

How to apply
Send your CV and a short cover letter to info@tnbyggjarfalla.se, with "Carpenter" and your name in the subject line. In your letter, briefly describe the types of projects you have worked on in recent years and which of the tasks above you have most experience in.
Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the positions may be filled before the closing date. First interviews are held by video call.
If you have any questions, you are welcome to contact us at info@tnbyggjarfalla.se.

We are looking for a  Talent Acquisition Specialist for a company in Solna. Start is ASAP, 7 months limited contract to begin with. This role is full-time and hybrid with at least 3 days per week onsite in Solna.

Main Focus
Your primary focus will be on proactive search and sourcing of senior and niche IT and technology professionals for recruitment, including specialist and key competencies within our consulting business.

The assignment may also include search activities within areas such as Sales and Executive/Leadership positions.
You will work hands-on with mapping the market, identifying the right talent, and engaging with candidates who are not actively looking for new opportunities.

•An established professional network and strong knowledge of the Swedish market for senior IT consultants and specialists.
•Experience independently managing the full search process, from requirements definition and market mapping through candidate identification, engagement, screening, and presentation.
•Fluency in Swedish and English.

This is a full-time consultant position in Solna through Incluso. Start is ASAP, 7 months limited contract to begin with. This role is full-time and hybrid with at least 3 days per week onsite in Solna.

 Please submit your CV as soon as possible since we will review the applications on an on-going basis.

For more information about this role, please contact Marianne Nilsson recruiter at Incluso.

WE ARE HIRING!
Part-Time Delivery Driver – One Day per Week
Omami – Asian Street Food | Gothenburg, Sweden
Location: Gothenburg (Göteborg), Sweden
 Employment Type: Part-Time (1 Day per Week)
 Company: Omami Group AB
 Start Date: As soon as possible / By agreement
About Omami
Omami is a growing Asian Street Food restaurant chain in Sweden, committed to delivering fresh, high-quality food and exceptional guest experiences. As we continue to expand, we are looking for a reliable, responsible, and punctual Part-Time Delivery Driver to support our restaurant operations and logistics.
Job Description
We are seeking a motivated driver to manage our weekly deliveries between Gothenburg and our restaurant locations. The ideal candidate is organised, dependable, and comfortable driving between cities while ensuring timely and safe deliveries.
Weekly Driving Route:
Gothenburg → Ulricehamn → Brämhult → Varberg → Gothenburg
Working Schedule: One day per week, with working hours agreed upon based on delivery requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Collect food supplies, packaging materials, and other restaurant essentials from the designated pickup location.
Deliver supplies safely and on time to Omami restaurant locations along the assigned route.
Load and unload goods carefully and efficiently.
Check delivery quantities and ensure accurate handovers.
Maintain proper handling and hygiene standards when transporting food products.
Communicate with restaurant managers and the operations team regarding deliveries.
Follow Swedish road safety regulations and company procedures.
Maintain cleanliness and report any issues with the delivery vehicle.

Requirements
Valid Swedish or EU Category B driving licence.
Good driving record and responsible driving habits.
Punctual, reliable, and able to work independently.
Physically capable of loading and unloading delivery items.
Good communication skills in English or Swedish.
Familiarity with roads in Västra Götaland and Halland is an advantage.
Previous delivery or logistics experience is preferred but not mandatory.

What We Offer
Flexible part-time employment – only one day per week.
A consistent weekly delivery route.
A friendly and supportive working environment.
Opportunity to be part of a growing restaurant chain in Sweden.
Competitive hourly compensation based on experience and agreement.

How to Apply
Interested candidates are welcome to submit a brief introduction, relevant driving experience, and contact details.
Email: hr@omamigroup.se
 Subject: Application – Part-Time Delivery Driver
Join Omami and become an important part of our growing Asian Street Food journey!
OMAMI – ASIAN STREET FOOD
 Great Food. Great People. Great Experience.

jobs.occupation: Head of HW, SW and Communications
jobs.description:
Saab is a place where teamwork makes things fly. Literally. Join us and experience our supportive and friendly workplace.

Your role

As Head of computer HW, SW and Communications at Saab Surveillance, you are responsible for leading and developing a team of Strategic and Operative Buyers within a designated procurement category and towards a specific site and related business units. You will support execution of procurement strategies, foster supplier relationships, and ensure delivery, quality, and cost performance. This role is placed in Järfälla/Solna Strand.
Main responsibilities:
Personnel responsibility for the team assigned
Commercial responsibility for all supplier base 
Quality, delivery and cost performance from the suppliers
Establishing relationships with internal and external stakeholders
Agreement coverage, operational development of processes, methods and tools together with Procurement driver and Process owner
Securing business compliance towards internal and external business requirement

Your profile

We are looking for a person with strong belief in competence and commitment from our employees. As a manager, you demonstrate communicative leadership skills to create commitment and energy within the organization. Your ability to establish a performance-driven culture within your unit will be important.
We also assume you have:
Previous managerial experience or extensive experience in strategic sourcing roles
Educational background in engineering, logistics, or economics
Strong leadership skills with a solution-oriented and proactive approach
High engagement and networking skills to establish cross-functional networks across all Saab Surveillance sites
Business-driven mindset with the ability to prioritize work effectively
Fluency in Swedish and English

This position requires that you pass a security vetting based on the current regulations around/of security protection. For positions requiring security clearance additional obligations on citizenship may apply.

What you will be part of

Explore a wealth of possibilities. Take on challenges, create smart inventions, and grow beyond. This is a place for curious minds, brave pioneers, and everyone in between. Together, we achieve the extraordinary, each bringing our unique perspectives. Your part matters.
Saab is a leading defense and security company with an enduring purpose, to help nations keep their people and society safe. Empowered by talented people, Saab constantly pushes the boundaries of technology to create a safer and more sustainable world.
Saab designs, manufactures and maintains advanced systems in aeronautics, weapons, command and control, sensors and underwater systems. Saab is headquartered in Sweden. It has major operations all over the world and is part of the domestic defense capability of several nations. Read more about us here.

Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
 Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking a Data Engineer with a focus on data catalog capabilities. This consulting assignment is central to the development and governance of metadata, data lineage, data quality, and automation within a modern data and cloud platform.
The role involves onboarding metadata from multiple source systems into the data catalog, maintaining traceability from source to consumption, and supporting data quality initiatives. You will work closely with Data Engineers, DevOps specialists, Data Stewards, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure that technical data assets are accurately documented and connected to relevant business concepts.
Key Responsibilities
Onboard metadata from databases, reporting tools, data pipelines, APIs, and other source systems into the data catalog.
Ensure that tables, columns, reports, APIs, and related technical assets are described accurately and consistently.
Create, maintain, and improve end-to-end data lineage from source systems through transformation pipelines to downstream consumption.
Support the implementation of data quality rules and expose data quality results through the catalog.
Develop scripts and supporting tools to automate metadata ingestion and catalog-related workflows.
Integrate automation into established CI/CD pipelines.
Collaborate with Data Stewards to map technical data objects to business terms and definitions.
Work cross-functionally with engineering, DevOps, architecture, governance, and business teams.

Technical Stack & Requirements
SQL: Advanced proficiency is required.
Scripting: Experience with Python or another scripting language is preferred.
Data engineering: Practical experience with ETL/ELT processes and data pipelines.
DevOps: Experience using Git and integrating solutions into CI/CD workflows.
Data catalogs: Experience with Alation, Collibra, Microsoft Purview, or AB Initio is advantageous.
Data governance capabilities: Experience with metadata management, data lineage, and data quality frameworks is advantageous.
Platforms: Experience working with modern data and cloud platforms is beneficial.

Qualifications & Experience
You should have several years of experience as a Data Engineer, BI Developer, or in a comparable data-focused role. The assignment requires a strong interest in metadata, structured information, and data traceability. Experience from a regulated organization—particularly banking, financial services, or insurance—is advantageous. Professional fluency in both Swedish and English is required.

Job Overview
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an experienced Design Engineer Consultant for a long-term assignment focused on chassis integration for battery-electric heavy-duty vehicle solutions. The role covers the mechanical design and integration of components and systems within the chassis, including sheet metal parts, plastic components, installation solutions, component packaging, and chassis interfaces. Experience in at least one of these technical areas is required, while broader experience across several areas is advantageous.
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop mechanical components and installation solutions for battery-electric heavy-duty vehicle chassis.
Create and maintain 3D models and 2D drawings in CATIA V5 in accordance with applicable engineering and design standards.
Manage component packaging, mechanical interfaces, tolerances, and installation requirements within the chassis environment.
Develop solutions that account for manufacturability, particularly for sheet metal, plastic, and pneumatic components.
Collaborate with suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams throughout the development process.
Participate in design reviews, validation activities, and technical investigations.
Maintain accurate technical documentation and provide engineering support to production when required.
Independently drive design activities while contributing technical knowledge to the wider team.

Technical Stack & Requirements
CAD: Advanced practical experience with CATIA V5 for both 3D modeling and 2D engineering drawings.
Mechanical design: Strong competence in sheet metal design and/or plastic component design.
Engineering analysis: Experience performing tolerance analysis and managing dimensional requirements.
Integration: Good understanding of component packaging, mechanical interfaces, installation constraints, and chassis integration.
Manufacturing: Knowledge of design-for-manufacturing principles for sheet metal, plastic, and/or pneumatic components.
Vehicle development: Previous research and development experience involving heavy-duty vehicles.

Qualifications & Experience
A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in a relevant engineering discipline is required, together with at least three years of professional design engineering experience. Candidates must have previous R&D experience from heavy-duty vehicle development and be fluent in English. Previous experience with chassis design and component installation for heavy-duty vehicles is advantageous, as is experience spanning several of the relevant technical areas. The assignment requires the ability to drive design work independently and collaborate effectively with suppliers and cross-functional teams.

About the Role
We are looking for an experienced and customer-oriented Senior Solution & Service Engineer to join our team in Sweden.
In this role, you will be responsible for providing comprehensive technical support throughout the customer journey, from pre-sales consultation and system solution design to after-sales service and troubleshooting.
You will work closely with Sales, Product, Service and R&D teams to support customers, deliver effective technical solutions, and contribute to continuous product and service improvements in the Swedish market.
Key Responsibilities
Provide pre-sales technical support to Sales Managers, distributors, installers, EPCs and key customers, including product selection, system configuration and technical solution development.
Deliver after-sales technical support, troubleshooting installation, commissioning, communication, software and product-related issues.
Build and maintain strong technical relationships with key customers through regular meetings, customer visits and project support.
Support new product launches, technical training sessions, webinars, workshops and customer events in Nordic region.
Gather customer requirements, market feedback and recurring technical issues, and communicate insights to the Product and R&D teams.
Support local product testing and validation, including firmware, software, compatibility and system integration testing.
Maintain and localise technical documentation, including product manuals, FAQs, troubleshooting guides and training materials.
Collaborate closely with Sales, Product, Service and R&D teams to ensure timely and effective resolution of customer and product-related issues.

Requirements
A degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Energy Engineering or a related technical field.
At least 5 years of relevant professional experience in technical support, solution engineering, field service or a similar engineering role.
Solid technical knowledge and practical experience in product configuration, system integration, installation and commissioning.
Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify technical issues and provide effective solutions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with customers and cross-functional teams.
A customer-oriented mindset, strong sense of ownership and the ability to work independently.
Good command of English, both written and spoken. Swedish language skills are considered an advantage.
Willingness to travel within Sweden when required.

Why Join Us?
Work in an international and collaborative environment.
Take on a key technical role supporting customers and business growth in the Nordic market.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams and contribute to product and service improvements.
Be part of a growing business in a technology-driven industry.

Interested?
If you have solid technical experience, enjoy solving complex technical challenges and building strong customer relationships, we would love to hear from you.
Please submit your CV and join our team!

 About the service
Role Summary
Our client is seeking an Electrical Design Engineer to develop electrical and automation solutions for advanced industrial products. The assignment covers electrical design, control systems, machine safety, and technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle. Working in an international engineering environment, the engineer will collaborate closely with multiple technical disciplines to deliver robust, standardized, modular, and compliant solutions for industrial machinery and automation systems.
Key Responsibilities
Design electrical systems, automation control panels, and electrical installations for advanced industrial products.
Create and maintain electrical schematics, technical specifications, engineering calculations, and test documentation.
Develop control systems and automation solutions in collaboration with other engineering disciplines.
Perform risk assessments and participate in technical design reviews.
Plan and execute testing, verification, and troubleshooting of electrical and automation solutions.
Support machine-safety activities and ensure that designs meet applicable technical and regulatory requirements.
Contribute to modularization and standardization initiatives for electrical designs and engineering methods.
Maintain accurate technical documentation throughout the product lifecycle.

Electrical engineering: Industrial electrical design, electrical installations, control panels, schematics, calculations, sensors, instrumentation, and electrical components.
Automation and control: Practical experience designing solutions for industrial machinery or automation systems.
Electrical CAD: Professional experience with EPLAN Electric P8 or an equivalent electrical CAD platform.
Advantageous engineering tools: EPLAN Pro Panel, Cogineer/eBuild, and Autodesk Inventor.
Product lifecycle systems: Experience with Teamcenter or another PDM/PLM platform is advantageous.

Fluency in English is required for collaboration and documentation within the international engineering environment.

jobs.occupation: We seek nurses for long-term positions in Østfold
jobs.description:
We are recruiting registered nurses for permanent full-time positions in the Østfold region in southeastern Norway, on behalf of several municipalities.
Østfold is a welcoming region in southeastern Norway, known for its beautiful coastline, scenic landscapes and close proximity to Oslo and Sweden. The municipalities have a continuous need for qualified nurses in both home care services and nursing homes, where you will play an important role in providing safe and reliable care to patients of all ages.
These positions offer a stable job, a meaningful everyday working life and good opportunities for professional development within the Norwegian public healthcare system. You will work in well-organised teams that focus on cooperation, clear routines and high professional standards.
Your responsibilities
Clinical nursing in home care, nursing homes or assisted living facilities
Observation, assessment, medication management and accurate documentation
Follow-up of patients with diverse medical conditions and functional levels
Collaboration with relatives, coordinating units and external partners
Interdisciplinary cooperation with doctors, therapists and other health professionals
Contributing to service development, improvement work and quality assurance

Qualifications:
Hold a valid nursing authorization from an EU country
Relevant experience as a nurse (hospital or community care is an advantage)
Be proficient with basic computer skills, necessary for modern healthcare environments
Speak and write English fluently
Motivated to learn Norwegian
Hold a bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN)
Driving licence category B is an advantage for home visits

Personal qualities:
Responsible, structured and solution oriented
Positive attitude and good teamwork skills
Flexible and comfortable with varied tasks
Motivated to contribute to a small but highly competent interdisciplinary team

We offer:
A full-time permanent position in the Norwegian public healthcare system
Competitive salary and working conditions
A supportive work environment that values cooperation and professional confidence
Opportunities for further development and specialization
Free online Norwegian language course with a private teacher
Relocation assistance and help with housing
Personal follow-up throughout the recruitment and relocation process

Why choose this opportunity?
Combine a rewarding nursing career with a great quality of life in Østfold. Enjoy the region’s beautiful coastline, peaceful surroundings and easy access to Oslo and Sweden. We will support you throughout the process to help you succeed in your new role.
 
Ready to apply?
Send us your application, and we will evaluate candidates continuously. Feel free to reach out for more information, I look forward to hearing from you!

Mission Brief 
As a Mechanical Technician at our rocket engine test site in Kiruna, you will play a vital role in supporting engine development and flight test operations. You will help operate, maintain, and upgrade state-of-the-art test facilities, engines, and related components. Your work will directly contribute to the safe and efficient testing of rocket engines and support our broader space mission.
Your Role in Our Space Mission: 
Perform assembly, maintenance, calibration, and repair of mechanical systems—including test rigs, rocket engines, high-pressure gas systems, and facility infrastructure.
Support test operations by preparing mechanical systems—including test rigs, rocket engines, high-pressure gas systems, and facility infrastructure.
Support commissioning, pressure testing, and engine hotfire activities by preparing equipment, following operational procedures, and documenting results.
Troubleshoot mechanical issues with engines and test facility systems, collaborating with your team and other functions (e.g., engineering, logistics) to resolve problems efficiently.
Assist with the installation and configuration of test equipment, ensuring correct setup for various test scenarios.
Follow established operational and safety procedures to ensure all activities are conducted safely and in accordance with company and regulatory requirements.
Maintain accurate records of maintenance, calibration, test activities, and incidents, as per company policy.
Participate in regular safety briefings and training to maintain high standards of competence.
Proactively suggest improvements to processes, tooling, and equipment to enhance safety, reliability, and efficiency.
Maintain the cleanliness, organization, and readiness of work areas, tools, and equipment.

Qualification Checklist 

At least 3 years of experience in a technical, hands-on mechanical role (preferably in aerospace, energy, or high-pressure systems).
Practical experience with hazardous systems/environments (e.g., cryogenics, pyrophorics, explosive atmospheres) is highly valued.
Hands-on experience with high-pressure gas systems: assembly, commissioning, leak checking, and operation.
Strong mechanical aptitude and proficiency in the use of hand and power tools, measurement instruments, and test equipment.
Familiarity with maintenance and troubleshooting of complex mechanical and fluid systems.
Basic proficiency in reading and interpreting technical drawings, schematics, and procedures.
Safety-conscious mindset and knowledge of relevant safety regulations and compliance standards.
Effective communication skills and ability to work collaboratively within a multidisciplinary team.
Good organizational skills and attention to detail.
Fluent in English, both spoken and written.

Bonus Skills
Experience in a development test environment, especially with cryogenics and high-pressure gas systems.
Relevant technical education, certifications, or licenses.
Experience with CAD software and MS Office suite.
Ability to work well under pressure and manage multiple priorities.
Strong problem-solving skills and initiative

jobs.occupation: Data Engineer  AWS, Python & Data Pipelines - 206022
jobs.description:
Veritaz is a leading IT staffing solutions provider in Sweden, committed to advancing individual careers and aiding employers in ensuring the perfect talent fit. With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.
Job Overview
Assignment Description
We are looking for a Data Engineer to design, build, test, deploy and operate secure and reliable data pipelines and engineering services on AWS.
This is a hands-on software and data engineering role focused on production code, cloud infrastructure, automation and service reliability — not data analysis or dashboard development.
You will work within a cross-functional engineering team, building data ingestion, processing and integration services that support business applications, credit operations, reporting and AI workloads.
What You Will Work On
Build and maintain production data pipelines using Python, Spark, APIs and Kafka.
Develop batch and streaming data ingestion services and reusable components.
Handle schema changes, incremental loads, failures, retries and data reprocessing.
Provision and configure AWS infrastructure using Terraform, including S3, IAM and EKS-related workloads.
Implement automated testing, CI/CD, data validation and reconciliation checks.
Monitor production pipelines, investigate incidents and improve service reliability.
Maintain alerts, runbooks and recovery procedures.
Apply security controls such as least-privilege access, encryption and secrets management.
Optimise pipeline performance, resource usage and cloud costs.
Document technical solutions, interfaces, dependencies and data lineage.
Use approved AI-assisted engineering tools responsibly.

What You Bring
Demonstrated experience building, deploying and supporting production data pipelines or data-platform services.
Practical experience with Python and AWS.
Strong software engineering skills, including Git, code reviews, automated testing and CI/CD.
Experience with Spark, Kafka and API-based data ingestion.
Knowledge of AWS services, including S3, IAM, encryption, logging and networking.
Experience with Terraform and infrastructure automation.
Understanding of Kubernetes/EKS and containerised workloads where required.
Experience with Airflow orchestration and production monitoring.
Good knowledge of SQL, data schemas, file formats and technical data models.
Understanding of data quality, observability, recovery and performance optimisation.
Fluent English and strong technical communication skills.
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.

Meritorious
Banking and financial data experience.
Relevant AWS certifications.
Experience with legacy data migrations.
Experience with dbt.
Experience with large-scale batch and streaming data platforms.

HOSTEL / HOTEL MANAGER
Stockholm, Sweden
We are looking for a hands-on Hostel / Hotel Manager to join our growing hospitality company in central Stockholm. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys combining team management with the practical, day-to-day operation of a hostel.
Who we are looking for
Fluent and confident in English, both spoken and written.
Preferably 3+ years of experience in hospitality, including experience in a managerial or supervisory role.
Responsible, organized and attentive to detail.
Follows the set procedures and makes sure that his team does so as well.
Comfortable using computers, basic Excel and different online systems and tools.
Confident managing, supporting and motivating a small team.
Hands-on and willing to help with cleaning, maintenance or other practical tasks when needed.
Positive, communicative and social, with an interest in travel, hospitality and meeting people from around the world.
Able to work independently, take initiative and solve problems as they arise.

The role
As Hostel / Hotel Manager, you are responsible for the smooth day-to-day operation of the property. Your responsibilities include:
Managing and overseeing a small on-site team of 1–3 people.
Working in the hostel reception and assisting guests when needed.
Planning staff schedules and coordinating daily tasks.
Overseeing daily operations, supplies, linen orders and general organization.
Ensuring that rooms and common areas meet our cleanliness and quality standards.
Assisting with cleaning when needed.
Handling minor maintenance and practical issues.
Communicating and coordinating with our online reception and remote team.

The position is approximately 40–50 hours per week, working in shifts during the hostel's operating hours, with 1–2 days off per week. As manager, you have flexibility to organize your own schedule according to the needs of the property.
About us
We are a growing hospitality company operating hostels in central Stockholm, with the ambition to build an international hostel group characterized by Scandinavian design and the Nomad concept.
Our organization combines an on-site team with an online team and online reception. For the right person, there are excellent opportunities to grow with the company and take on greater responsibility as we expand.
What we offer
Salary: 30,000 SEK/month gross
Relocation: Flight to Stockholm included
Accommodation: Affordable staff accommodation available at the hostel
Vacation: One month paid vacation per year
You will work in an international environment, meet people from all over the world and have the opportunity to develop your management, hospitality and communication skills while experiencing life in Stockholm.

Are you interested in working in a high-tech environment at multiple OEMs, while still maintaining a good work/life-balance? Keep on reading!   
Welcome to Europe’s most thriving automotive high-tech cluster 
In Gothenburg there are not less than 4 automotive OEMs, and together with the tier one suppliers we are positioned in the center of Europe’s most thriving automotive high-tech cluster. MCA have projects with 20+ different companies which create a vast number of possibilities for you as an MCA consultant.  
This is an on-site position, but don’t worry, Sweden is a great place to live! We are consistently ranked among the top 10 countries in the World Happiness Report, with a high level of social security and big focus on work/life-balance. On top of this, the tech scene in in Sweden are extremely hot, with everything from the high-tech automotive OEMs to a thriving start-up culture, so you will have all the chances to have a stimulating career development.  
So, if you want a thrilling career in the tech-dense city of Gothenburg surrounded by beautiful nature, great work culture and still with time over for your private projects and hobbies keep on reading!  
The job 
You will work as a consultant for one of our many exciting clients. You will be involved in the development of new, state-of-the-art automotive software platforms that will enable groundbreaking progress in the fields of autonomous drive, connected vehicles and electromobility to mention a few.  
Most of our clients work in agile cross functional teams. The team has full ownership of its features. This means that you will be involved in all stages of development, from design, implementation, and testing.  
We offer you the chance to work with cutting-edge technology, with the support of our dedicated consultant managers who will help you take your career to new heights! 
The ideal profile 
We want you to be curious and engaged, ready to take on new challenges and contribute to the development at our clients. You have great skills in communication and a flexible mindset. You need an engineering master and relevant working experience, preferably within embedded software.   
Qualifications: 
Master’s degree in electrical engineering, computer science, mechatronics or similar 
5+ years of experience from embedded software development  
Fluent in English 
EU citizen and EU drivers license   

If you find this opportunity interesting, please apply as soon as possible!

At Tesla, our Service Technicians are the backbone of the Service operation, supporting our mission to build a world of amazing abundance.
We’ve created one of the most innovative vehicles ever made, and as a Service Technician you will help ensure an equally innovative service to our customers. To succeed at Tesla, you must be energetic, highly organized, and smart working. You should have a passion for the brand and the ability to build on your technical skill set and thrive in a team environment. 
Are you up for the challenge?
We offer
• A dynamic & fast-paced environment where inclusion, learning & collaboration are key to success
• The chance to work with innovative technology, advanced tools and software
• Ongoing training and development to help you grow your skills and career
• A competitive compensation and benefits package 
• A safe, clean and fun workplace

Responsibilities
Service, repair and improve: Working with Tesla specific software and advanced tools you will be performing repairs and maintenance on all types of Tesla vehicles.
Driven: Efficient in completing repairs and driven to exceed expectations on quality and productivity. Become proficient to perform all common repairs and some complex repairs autonomously.
Ensure top quality: Fix it right first time, we trust you to inspect our vehicles diligently before return and pre-delivery
Collaborate: Working across teams (local and over the region) you will be sharing support and best practices in order to further improve the service experience. 
Develop: Setting you up for success our dedicated in-house training teams offer a blended learning strategy to help develop your technical skills. And by also sharing your own skills and knowledge with the team, you’re a part of driving the whole group forward.

Requirements
Technically experienced: You have professional experience performing vehicle service and repairs working within either automotive, aviation, marine or similar industries. 
Technically qualified: You have relevant certification to perform vehicle repairs in Sweden. You will self-manage your technical expertise development.
A good communicator: You speak and write English well and know how to get your point across clearly and respectfully.
Safe to drive: We require you to hold a driver’s license.
Flexible: You may work in shifts to support your team, which may include weekends, morning and evening shifts. You are willing to travel when needed.
Eligible: to work in Sweden.
